result.title: Dense Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning in a Unified Geometry State
result.summary: Geometry reasoning is naturally stateful: solving a problem repeatedly alternates between structural proposals and exact deductions. We formulate this process as dense neural-symbolic coupling, in which neural guidance and symbolic execution share a typed state and communicate through executable actions at every search step. Neural proposals contribute theorem instances, constructions, and algebraic bridges; the symbolic runtime applies registered rules, propagates exact constraints, and records provenance. A nested controller allocates computation first between neural and symbolic proposal sources and then among admitted actions. We instantiate the framework in OmniGeo, a single solver for plane, analytic, and solid geometry. With Claude Sonnet 4.6, OmniGeo reaches 94.2%, 88.5%, and 89.8% on FormalGeo7K, Conic10K, and SolidFGeo, respectively (90.8% macro average), and solves 21/30 IMO-AG-30 problems.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出“稠密神经-符号耦合”几何推理框架 OmniGeo，让神经网络提议与符号执行共享同一类型化状态、按步通过可执行动作交互，并用嵌套控制器分配神经/符号提议与已准入动作之间的计算预算，在多个几何基准上取得较高成绩。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 无直接视觉推理关联，但其“类型化共享状态+嵌套控制器动态分配计算”可供核查：这类状态更新与计算分配机制可能为 latent 推理状态的更新及 THINK/LOOK/STOP 式的决策成本建模提供线索。
